name: 84095 · South Jordan, UT
findings: ZIP 84095 (South Jordan) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84095 (South Jordan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84095 (South Jordan) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
